preoutcome: Do not launch any subject trial until all six rendered artifacts have immutable digests and pass canonical coverage, semantic equivalence, speech-act equivalence, salience, and actual-artifact manipulation gates.
Do not launch if the subject configuration or any contract binding fails verification.
Do not launch if any task or key entered profile extraction or treatment validation context.
execution: Every trial uses a fresh context and the exact scheduled artifact, task, evidence packet, and scripted turns.
Never rerun, replace, salvage, or substitute a scheduled trial. A failed attempt remains invalid with its evidence chain.
Stop at a known model, backend, client, service-tier, reasoning, tool-policy, or platform boundary.
Stop when a fifth trial becomes invalid or materially deviates, because fewer than 44 of 48 valid trials cannot satisfy the 90 percent operational gate.
No efficacy, futility, or condition-aware early stopping is permitted.

budget_calibration.meter_rule: Record the same weekly-usage surface immediately before T001 and after T008; let the observed difference be u percentage points.
budget_calibration.full_batch_gate: Proceed only when 6 * u + 10 <= 70 and no other stop rule fired.
budget_calibration.failure_disposition: If the projection exceeds 70, stop before T009. Any revised model, repetition count, or billing surface requires a fresh schedule and contract; the eight observations are not substituted into that new experiment.

terminal: After the frozen 48 scheduled attempts, stop. Additional trials require a fresh experiment ID and preregistration.
